name: plumbline
description: AI-native construction management platform: one record kernel instead of two dozen hand-built tools

scripts.build: npm run build -w @plumbline/shared && npm run build -w @plumbline/api && npm run build -w @plumbline/web
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @plumbline/shared && npm run build -w @plumbline/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @plumbline/shared && npm run typecheck -w @plumbline/api && npm run typecheck -w @plumbline/web
